reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. The reply confirms that the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Dock 23.

I didn't save it to gbrain because gbrain blocked me before it read or stored anything. The connection's access token isn't linked to any member, so every request is refused. That means her channel message is the only record for now. The fix has to be run by an admin on the gbrain server, using `gbrain auth rescope`.
